hooks.command: powershell -NonInteractive -Command "Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Windows.Forms; $n = New-Object System.Windows.Forms.NotifyIcon; $n.Icon = [System.Drawing.SystemIcons]::Information; $n.Visible = $true; $n.ShowBalloonTip(8000, 'Claude Code', 'Ich bin fertig! Schau mal rein.', [System.Windows.Forms.ToolTipIcon]::Info); Start-Sleep -Seconds 2; $n.Dispose()"
